{{small|([[CEO|MD & CEO]])}}{{cite web |last1=Bureau |first1=Our |title=New CEO at LIC Housing Finance |url=http://businessnewsthisweek.com/business/shri-tribhuwan-adhikari-takes-over-as-coo-of-lic-housing-finance-ltd/ |website=@businessnews |date=28 June 2023 |access-date=28 June 2023 |language=en}} | products = [[Home loans]] and [[Mortgage loans]] | revenue = {{up}}{{INRConvert|20005|c}}(2023){{Cite web|url=https://www.bseindia.com/stock-share-price/lic-housing-finance-ltd/lichsgfin/500253/financials-results-special/|title=LIC-HFL Annual Trends}} | operating_income = {{down}}{{INRConvert|16963|c}}(2023) | parent = [[Life Insurance Corporation of India]] | net_income = {{down}}{{INRConvert|2286|c}}(2023) | assets = {{up}} {{INRConvert|254687|c}} (2023) | equity = {{up}} {{INRConvert|24751|c}} (2023) | num_employees = 2,103 | subsidiaries = {{ubl|LIC HFL Care Homes Limited | LIC HFL Financial Services Limited |LIC HFL Asset Management Company Private Limited}} | footnotes = | founded = {{start date and age|1989|06|19|df=yes|p=yes}} | hq_location = [[Mumbai]], [[India]] | website = {{URL|lichousing.com}} }} '''LIC Housing Finance Limited''' ('''LIC HFL''') is the largest Housing Finance Company in India, with a registered corporate office in [[Mumbai]]. It is a deposit taking housing finance company, and it is a subsidiary of [[Life Insurance Corporation|LIC]], mainly providing long-term financing to people who purchase or construct residential houses or flats. It also finances the repair and renovation of existing residences and gives loans to businesses to purchase or construct clinics, nursing homes, diagnostic centres, office space or equipment.{{cite web|url=http://www.lichousing.com/aboutus.php|title=About Us - Company Profile|publisher=LIC Housing Finance Ltd|accessdate=10 April 2015}} ==History== The company was incorporated on 19 June 1989, under the [[Companies Act, 1956]]. It was promoted by [[Life Insurance Corporation of India]] and went public in the year 1994. The maiden [[global depository receipt]] (GDR) issue was launched in 2004.{{Cite web|url=https://www.bourse.lu/security/US50186U2033/78703|title=LICHousingFin GDS - US50186U2033 - Luxembourg Stock Exchange|website=www.bourse.lu|access-date=2019-07-06}} The Authorized Capital of the company is Rs.1500 Million (Rs.150 crore) and its paid-up Capital is Rs.1009.9 Million (Rs.100.99 crore). The company is registered with [[National Housing Bank]] and listed on the [[National Stock Exchange of India|National Stock Exchange]] (NSE) & [[Bombay Stock Exchange Limited]] (BSE) and its shares are traded only in Demat format. The GDR's are listed on the [[Luxembourg Stock Exchange]]. ==Operations== In FY-2019, it had 9 regional offices, 24 Back-offices, and 282 marketing Offices across India. It also has 2 foreign offices in Kuwait and Dubai to cater to the Non-Resident Indians in the [[Arab states of the Persian Gulf|Persian Gulf countries]] covering the residents of Bahrain, Dubai, Kuwait, Qatar, and Saudi Arabia. It has more than 450 centres across India. The company also has more than 12000 marketing intermediaries or agents to guide through the loan processes. It also has an online home loan approvals facility through its website.{{cite news |url=http://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/lic-housing-examining-opportunitiesspore-malaysia_730292.html |title=LIC Housing 'examining' opportunities in S'pore, Malaysia |date=13 July 2012 |publisher=moneycontrol.com |accessdate=16 July 2012}} ==Listing== The equity shares of LIC HFL are listed on the [[Bombay Stock Exchange]] and the [[National Stock Exchange of India]]. Its [[Global depository receipt]]s are listed on the [[Luxembourg Stock Exchange]]. ==Shareholders== As of 31 March 2016, 48.49% of the [[Common stock|equity shares]] of the company were owned by [[Life Insurance Corporation of India|LIC]]. The Foreign Institutional Investors (FII) held approx. 32% of the shares. Around 158,000 individual public shareholders own approximately 9% of its shares. The remaining 18% shares are owned by others.{{cite web |url=http://www.lichfl.com//lichousing/aboutus/share_holding_pattern.asp |title=Shareholding pattern |publisher=LIC HFL Limited |date=30 September 2013 |accessdate=12 December 2013}} {| class="wikitable" |- ! Shareholders (as on 31 March 2016)!! Shareholding |- | Promoter ([[Life Insurance Corporation of India|LIC]])||40.31% |- | Foreign Institutional Investors (FII)||32.45% |- | Mutual Funds||10.12% |- | Individual shareholders||09.32% |- | Bodies Corporate||03.47% |- | Insurance companies||02.08% |- | GDRs||00.16% |- | Others||02.09% |-800000 |- |} ==Employees== The company had 1345 employees as of 31 March 2013, out of which 444 were women (31%) and 4 were employees with disabilities.
In its Annual report for FY 2012–13, the company reported that loan assets per employee as at 31 March 2013 were Rs. 53.63 crore and net profit per employee was Rs. 70.51 lakh.{{cite web |url=http://www.lichfl.com//lichousing/aboutus/LIC%20Annual%20Report_2013.pdf |title=Annual Report 2012-13 |publisher=LIC HFL |accessdate=12 December 2013}} In the same financial year, it incurred INR 98.15 crore on employee benefit expenses. As of 2019, the company has a total of 2103 employees, with a net profit per employee amounting to approximately Rs. 94.62 lakh. == References == {{Reflist}} == External links == * {{Official website|http://www.lichfl.com}} * [https://web.archive.org/web/20160304001740/http://in.reuters.com/finance/stocks/overview?symbol=LICH.NS LIC HFL] at [[Reuters]] {{Portal|Companies}}{{Financial services in India}}{{Nifty 200 companies}} [[Category:Financial services companies established in 1989]] [[Category:Housing finance companies of India]] [[Category:Financial services companies based in Mumbai]] [[Category:Life Insurance Corporation]] [[Category:Indian companies established in 1989]] [[Category:1989 establishments in Maharashtra]] [[Category:Companies listed on the National Stock Exchange of India]] [[Category:Companies listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange]]
